perks.name: Stable Resonance
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Kill:
7% Increased Weapon Damage and Resist x2 (25% DR) for 12 seconds.

perks.name: Resonance Redirection
perks.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
perks.exact:
While Stable Resonance is active:
Dealing 600? Weapon Damage within ? seconds of each triggers an Exhausting Blast, centered on the enemy.
Incurs an 2? second cooldown between Exhausting Blasts.

Exhausting Blast deals ? Damage and inflicts Exhaust over 8 meters, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

item.name: Void Resistance
item.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
item.exact:
15% | 25% | 30% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Elemental Mods reduce Mod-Matching Elemental damage.
Sniper reduces damage from >30 metres.
Melee reduces damage from <5 metres.
Concussive Dampener reduces AoE/Blast/Explosive Damage.

Different Resist Mods, as well as other sources of Resist all stack multiplicatively with each other.
